messages:
andrea b: Heads-up I filed a docs PR to clear up tier boundaries + SDK examples. The dashboard label says '1k-10k' but our metering uses [min, max). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999

tom s: can you paste the tiny sample that mismatches so i can run quick check?

andrea b: sample in PR description:
```
user,requests
acct-1,999
acct-2,1000
acct-3,10000
```
acct-3 ended up in dashboard Tier 2 in examples but the billing CSV maps 10000 to Tier 3.

nina: we should standardize docs on half-open intervals. i'll update /reference/tiers.md and add an explicit line: "Tiers use half-open intervals [min, max). Values equal to max belong to the next tier."

dev-bot: quick CI note: linter flagged missing units in SDK snippet at /snippets/metering/js.md (header example `X-Quota: 1000`).

sara: i'll own the SDK snippet update — will add curl + node examples and inline comment with units, e.g. `X-Quota: 1000 (requests)`. also will show the sample mapping result so readers can reproduce.

andrea b: UX ask: keep pretty dashboard labels for readability but add a tooltip with exact semantics. can someone file a tiny dashboard-annotation PR?

tom s: i'll add the tooltip: text = "Labels are rounded; actual intervals are half-open [min, max)." will push PR against dashboards repo.

nina: also l10n flagged the migration guide linking to an internal sheet. swapped to public CSV in the PR but we should add an sha256 so integrators can verify their downloads.

sara: pushed snippet commit: shows header with units and a short js example. snippet ends with a small table showing which tier each sample row maps to under half-open rule.

andrea b: thanks. dev-bot, can you run the quick script to validate sample rows against the updated docs and new snippet?

dev-bot: test results: all sample rows map consistently now. no more off-by-one. CI green except for one small docs link lint; fixed in follow-up commit.

tom s: panel PR landed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dashboards/pull/210 - tooltip text included and panel description updated with a parenthetical note referencing the docs page.

andrea b: merging checklist: 1) docs: half-open interval note, 2) SDK snippet: units + examples, 3) dashboard: tooltip + desc note, 4) migration guide: public CSV + sha256, 5) l10n signoff. i'll merge after l10n approves translations. :thumbsup:
